{{Top|leg}}
A '''poniard''' was a type of bladed [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]]. Around the start of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Sele (Cathar)|Sele]], a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] working for [[Spa Fon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], owned a [[Sele's poniard|poniard]] that was roughly the same length and weight as a [[Jax Pavan|Jax Pavan's]] [[Limb/Legends|leg]].<ref name="CNII:SOS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Jax Pavan kept a [[Jax Pavan's duracris poniard|duracris poniard]] in a sheath between his shoulder blades.<ref name="CNI:JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>
